title: Algebraization of finite schemes over the thickenings of a scheme over a complete Noetherian ring
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal such that $A$ is $I$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]; put $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$ and $S_n=\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ for $n\ge0$. Let $X\to S$ be a separated morphism of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and $X_n=X\times_SS_n$ [def-pc-base-change], with the closed immersions $X_n\to X_{n+1}$. Suppose given schemes $Y_n$ with finite morphisms $f_n:Y_n\to X_n$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and morphisms $Y_n\to Y_{n+1}$ making the squares with $X_n\to X_{n+1}$ commute and cartesian ($Y_n\cong Y_{n+1}\times_{X_{n+1}}X_n$ over $X_n$), and assume $Y_0\to S_0$ (the composite $Y_0\to X_0\to S_0$) is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Then there exist a finite morphism $f:Y\to X$ and isomorphisms $Y\times_XX_n\cong Y_n$ of $X_n$-schemes, compatible with the maps $Y_n\to Y_{n+1}$; moreover $Y$ is proper over $S$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 09ZT (label lemma-algebraize-formal-scheme-finite-over-proper; there indexed by S_n = Spec(A/I^n), n >= 1), with its proof via Grothendieck's existence theorem (Theorem 088C, Remark reformulate-existence-theorem) and Lemma finite-pushforward-coherent

proof.text: Let j_n be the first pullback projection Xn -> X and i_n the specified transition pullback map. Its first projection equation gives i_n followed by j_(n+1) = j_n. Composing the commutativity of the given cartesian square with j_(n+1) proves g_n followed by (f_(n+1) followed by j_(n+1)) = f_n followed by j_n.

Algebraize the structure algebras using algebraize_finite_structure_algebra, obtaining the quasi-coherent coherent algebra B with proper support and its compatible quotient maps b_n. Realize B by exists_affine_structure_algebra, obtaining an affine g : Y -> X and an algebra isomorphism B = g_*O_Y.

X is locally Noetherian by LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian. Apply coherent_algebra_affine_finite_proper to g and B to obtain IsFinite g and IsProper(g followed by f). The j_n are closed immersions by the quotient Spec closed immersion instance and stability under base change; each f_n is affine because it is finite.

Apply affine_algebra_reductions_cartesian to the b_n and their quotient and compatibility properties. This produces v_n : Yn -> Y with cartesian squares (v_n,f_n,g,j_n), and g_n followed by v_(n+1) = v_n.

Set e_n to the inverse of the canonical isomorphism of each cartesian square with pullback g j_n. Its two projection equations give e_n followed by v_n = fst and e_n followed by f_n = snd. Define q_n by pullback.lift(fst, snd followed by i_n), using i_n followed by j_(n+1) = j_n and the pullback condition. Its projection identities are the required equations. For e_n followed by g_n = q_n followed by e_(n+1), use hom_ext for the cartesian square at n+1: equality after v_(n+1) follows from the compatibility of v and the fst equations; equality after f_(n+1) follows from the given square commutativity and the snd equations.
